title: NIDCD places waving and arms-up in a 7-month to 1-year band
summary: NIDCD's communication checklist puts gestures such as waving or holding the arms up in the band from 7 months to 1 year.
body: The National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders lists, under 7 months to 1 year, communicating with gestures such as waving or holding up the arms. The same page says children vary in speech and language, while still following a broad timetable. The band is wider than a single CDC month, and it mixes waving with the arms-up gesture. It is a US institute checklist, not a screen and not a statement about every baby. The page's last update shown was 13 October 2022.

sources.title: Speech and language developmental milestones

sources.note: Supports the 7-months-to-1-year checklist line on gestures such as waving or holding up arms, and the statement that children vary. US federal page, public domain. Paraphrased, not quoted.
